result.summary: The page renders well overall with consistent styling. Found one potential content issue involving duplicate restaurant listings.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two seemingly identical 'Green Bowl Poké' entries with the same image, delivery fee (€0.90) and time estimate (15-25 min), which may be an unintended duplicate.
issues.suggestion: Verify whether these are two distinct locations. If duplicated, de-duplicate the listing or add a distinguishing label (e.g., branch/location name).
